name: Ignite by 4-H Conference (Oregon delegation)
what_you_do: Join teens from across the country at a conference in Washington, DC. It has speakers and workshops on science, farming and healthy living. You make a plan for action in your community.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 19 who were in 4-H in the 2025-26 year (member, camp, event or in-school program) and have not attended a national 4-H event before. Must be able to travel to DC in March 2027 and to Portland airport. Oregon youth join a chaperoned group.
pay_detail: Event page lists $300. A donor covers a large part of the conference cost and airfare.
deadline_text: Applications close October 13, 2026 at 11:45 pm (the deadline was extended from October 1).
how_to_apply: Fill out the application form and upload a 2 to 4 minute video at beav.es/ignite2027 answering the prompt on the page. Do not use the national 4-h.org site.
notes: Requests for disability help are due Oct 31, 2026. This is a 4-H event named Ignite. It is not the same as the Ignition youth conference.
